Tocilizumab is a newer monoclonal antibody for treatment of rheumatoid arthritis. It acts against:
questions.solutionHtml:
IL6

IL-6 is a pleiotropic proinflammatory cytokine produced by various cell types, including lymphocytes, monocytes, and fibroblasts. SARS-CoV-2 infection induces a dose-dependent production of IL-6 from bronchial epithelial cells. This cascade of events is the rationale for studying IL-6 inhibitors like Tocilizumab.

A female patient on anti-hypertensive drugs comes for pre-conceptional counselling. Which of the following drugs will you advise to stop?
questions.solutionHtml:
Lisinopril
  • It is well accepted that angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitors are contraindicated during the second and third trimesters of pregnancy because of increased risk of fetal renal damage and other adverse outcomes like hypocalvaria and IUGR and hence should be advised for cessation.

questions.stem: A Patient with breathlessness, chest pain and irregularly irregular heart beat. She is a known case of mitral stenosis. Echo is normal and shows no thrombi. What is the best way to prevent thrombosis in this patient?
questions.solutionHtml:
Oral Warfarin

Oral Warfarin is an oral anticoagulant which helps prevent the formation of harmful blood clots in the legs, lungs, brain, and heart.

A Women regularly used aspirin for arthritis for pain relief for years. Later she developed intestinal bleeding. This developed due to inhibition of?
questions.solutionHtml:
Thromboxane
  • Thromboxanes are responsible for the aggregation of platelets that form blood clots. Low-dose, long-term aspirin use irreversibly blocks the formation of thromboxane A2 in platelets, producing an inhibitory effect on platelet aggregation; thus increasing the risk of internal bleeding. Usually, it causes bleeding in the gastrointestinal tract (primarily the stomach and small intestines), but bleeding can also occur in other areas of the body.

questions.stem: A Patient received halothane and developed increased body temperature and muscle rigidity. Administration of which of the following drug can increase the risk of present condition?
questions.solutionHtml:
Succinylcholine

Succinylcholine also known as suxamethonium or succinylcholine, or simply sux by medical abbreviation, is a medication used to cause short-term paralysis as part of general anesthesia. This is done to help with tracheal intubation or electroconvulsive therapy.
